CANADA / LAUNCH BRIEFING

Western Canada.
Regional distribution.

A proposed launch for MT E.L.K., INC. Partners, territories, and commercial terms remain to be confirmed.

My Field Guide →

Download Pilot Checklist

Use buttons, arrow keys, or swipe sideways on a slide. Show all slides for the full briefing.

01 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Western Canada first

Start with regional distributors in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

  • Verify which retailers each partner currently serves.
  • Match coverage to stocking and delivery capacity.
  • Choose the lead province later; no territory is assigned.
Review the Regional Plan →

02 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Distributor or dealer?

Distributors supply retailers. Dealers sell to hunters.

  • Supplying a chain’s own stores alone does not establish a wholesale network.
  • Ask who orders from the partner and how retailers replenish.
  • Keep distributor prospects and dealer accounts separate.
Prepare the Partner Discussion →

03 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Start with deer calling

A focused assortment from the earlier Canada launch proposal.

  • DEER TALK — The DEER STOPPER.
  • Replacement bands — 3-pack.
  • DEER TALK guide; confirm availability and opening quantities.
Plan Pilot Quantities →

04 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Show the call in use

Watch the selected passage from The Deer Hunter, starting at 32:18.

  • Let retail staff hear and compare the demonstrated sounds.
  • Close and reopen the embedded player if you need to retry playback.
  • Treat filmed responses as examples, not guaranteed outcomes.

05 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Equip the retail team

Use the English / French written guide. The source film is in English.

  • Follow timestamped passages rather than instructions inferred from titles.
  • Pair calling practice with the relevant band-replacement lesson.
  • Keep support contact details available to store staff.
Open the Learning Guide →

06 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Confirm terms before shipping

Agree on the operating responsibilities before an opening order.

  • Confirm pricing, currency, payment, and stock ownership.
  • Assign freight, import, returns, and replenishment responsibilities.
  • The earlier US$5,000 opening threshold remains unapproved.
Review Open Commercial Decisions →

07 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Verify the partner’s capacity

Prepare evidence for a regional distributor conversation.

  • Serviced retail accounts and actual coverage.
  • Warehouse capacity, replenishment plan, and training support.
  • Opening-order funding; partners and territories remain unconfirmed.
Prepare the Partner Discussion →

08 / 08 · MT E.L.K., INC.

Review results. Then expand.

Expand only after reviewing the pilot results.

  • Separate prospects, approved partners, first orders, and stocked stores.
  • Review reported sell-through, reorders, and support needs.
  • Agree on the next coverage step after the review.
Discuss the Pilot →
